name: Canvas Write
description: Put a result on a canvas as a new layer, straight onto the head: a new revision is made from the one Canvas Region read and the head moves to it, so the layer is there to keep, hide or delete (Undo removes it too). When something else moved the head while this ran, the layer is added onto the head as it is now (layers only add), and the node reports the head it landed on. When that is impossible (the canvas changed size while the run was going) the run says so and writes nothing. The picture is resized to the stitch's box and the new layer holds it whole, with a layer mask that blends it in: the mask softened outward by Blend pixels, as Stitch does (turn Bake the blend on to put the blend into the layer's own pixels instead, as before). The layer is named from the prompt that made the picture, else Fill 1, Fill 2 and so on. Or, with Onto set, no layer is added: the Layer mask picture becomes the layer mask of the layer of that name (a revision of its own, which Undo takes back), so a cut-out (Remove Background) hides what it removes and keeps its pixels; a locked layer refuses it.

inputs.name: canvas
inputs.label: Canvas
inputs.description: The canvas and the revision the work started from: Canvas Region's canvas output.

inputs.name: image
inputs.label: Image
inputs.description: The picture to place. With a stitch it must have the region's shape to within 2%; without one it covers the whole canvas. Needed unless Onto is set.

inputs.name: stitch
inputs.label: Stitch
inputs.description: Where the picture goes, and the mask to blend through: Canvas Region's stitch output.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.label: Mask
inputs.description: The mask to blend through, at the canvas's size. Without one, the stitch's, and without a stitch the whole picture.

inputs.name: blend
inputs.label: Blend
inputs.description: How far the edge of the mask fades outward, in canvas pixels.

inputs.name: bake
inputs.label: Bake the blend into the layer
inputs.description: Off: the layer is the redrawn picture whole and the blend is its layer mask, which can be turned off or edited later. On: the blend is put into the layer's pixels and there is no layer mask (the composite is the same).

inputs.name: name
inputs.label: Layer name
inputs.description: The new layer's name. Fill (the default) or empty names it from the prompt upstream (the Text Encode that made the picture), else Fill 1, Fill 2 and so on.

inputs.name: visible
inputs.label: Show the layer
inputs.description: Off: the layer lands hidden (the task bar's variations 2 to N), to be shown by its eye.

inputs.name: onto
inputs.label: Onto the mask of layer
inputs.description: Empty adds a new layer. A layer's name (the top one of that name) writes Layer mask as that layer's layer mask instead, inside the stitch's box and through the mask (the whole layer without a stitch), and leaves the rest of its mask as it was. A group, a picture layer or a mask layer has none to write here.

inputs.name: layer_mask
inputs.label: Layer mask
inputs.description: With Onto: the mask to put on the layer (white keeps, black hides), the region's size (Remove Background Mask's output) or the canvas's.

inputs.name: suffix
inputs.label: Name suffix
inputs.description: Put after the layer's name, with a space (the task bar's "(2 of 3)" for variations).

outputs.name: canvas
outputs.label: Canvas
outputs.description: The revision that holds the new layer.

outputs.name: accepted
outputs.label: Accepted
outputs.description: Whether the layer landed on the head (directly, or placed on a head that moved meanwhile). Always on: a result that cannot be placed fails the run.

outputs.name: head
outputs.label: Head
outputs.description: The canvas's head after the write: the revision that holds the new layer.
